purpose: App-wide typed entity search with URL-restored type facets, grouped navigable results and independently gated natural-language search.
primaryGoal: Find and open a vehicle, drive, charging session, alert, notification, geofence, automation, location or trip without losing query/filter context.

dataSources.name: Typed global search
dataSources.behavior: Enabled at two JavaScript string code units; optional known-type filter; 25 hits per type; key includes trimmed query, ordered types and limit; FAST stale policy; AbortSignal forwarded; prior valid-query payload retained as placeholderData. Null hits normalize to []. Backend checks two Unicode runes, caps total hits at 225 and preserves server ranking.
dataSources.limitations: Backend sub-search failures are logged and skipped without completeness metadata (handler.go:159-196). Database matching and individual PGSearcher implementations not inspected; no live endpoint exercised.

dataSources.name: Natural-language search
dataSources.behavior: Independent local prompt, maximum 4096 characters, whitespace-only prompt cannot start; explicit start streams accumulated prose/activity/usage through AIFeatureCard/AiOutputPanel. withAiFeature('nl-search') prevents mounting the inner source when disabled.
dataSources.limitations: Streaming/auth/provider behavior and real feature configuration unverified. This report does not invent structured result navigation or completeness guarantees for AI prose.

dataSources.name: URL state and derived presentation
dataSources.behavior: URL replacement preserves unrelated parameters; known types retain requested order; groups follow nine-type display order, within-group server order survives. Counts are bounded returned hits, occupied groups and selected filters. Largest group determines Top match; first display-order group wins ties. Operational metrics use existing preference-aware shared formatter.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.role: Shared full-width page/header, secondary refresh action and automatic query freshness; shell owns navigation/workspace.

components.name: Input / Button / GlassPanel / Badge / typography
components.role: Category-barrel primitives; search input, nine facet buttons, reset, grouped panels, counts, named row actions; PanelTitle/SectionTitle/Text roles.

components.name: SystemSummaryBrief / OperationalBrief
components.role: Existing domain adapter to canonical summary, metrics and details rather than a replacement KPI implementation.

components.name: EmptyState / QueryError / Skeleton / StaleRefreshWarning
components.role: Idle, minimum-length, pending, fatal retry, no-results and retained-source warning surfaces; no blank whole-page data gate.

components.name: TimeStamp
components.role: Existing optional timestamp formatter; implementation not traced.

components.name: FadeIn
components.role: Existing shared entrance motion; shared implementation disables initial transform/delay for reduced motion.

components.name: AINLSearch / AIFeatureCard / AiOutputPanel / withAiFeature
components.role: Optional independent AI feature, prompt/action/output/error/completion/provenance; keep canonical typed baseline visible when AI is off.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Nine entity icon/translated-label switch cases are independently repeated in CommandPalette.tsx:198-225 despite its shared-helper comment. Search requests already share useGlobalSearch; whole search UIs are intentionally distinct.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Centralize only typed entity presentation metadata/helper contract; preserve page 25-per-type versus palette 5-per-type and their distinct navigation/interaction contexts.

SearchPage.tsx:309 provides one column, md two, xl three, 3xl four; source breakpoints are viewport based even though PageLayout.tsx:13 establishes a container.

issues.detail: Facet buttons use fixed small-button height and do not opt into wrapLabel; long localized labels may exceed 320px allocation. Section labels are truncated at line 325 and a long shrink-0 timestamp competes with title at line 364. These are source risks, not measured overflow.
issues.fix: Use existing wrapLabel for facets and allow existing labels/timestamp to reflow or stack without dropping metadata; test narrow allocated widths, RTL and 200% text.

sourceEvidence: SearchPage.tsx:191 names the searchbox; 195-208 names the filter group and exposes pressed state.
SearchPage.tsx:163 names icon-only refresh; 307 names the results region; 339 provides localized row open labels.
SearchPage.tsx:389-404 hides decorative icons; result lists use ul/li; labels use shared typography.
Button.tsx:26-33 supplies shared focus ring; FadeIn.tsx:24-33 uses reduced-motion handling.

issues.detail: Entity destinations render as Buttons calling navigate(hit.url), not links; this removes native open-in-new-tab/copy-link affordances despite being navigation.
issues.fix: Compose native router Link navigation with existing shared button chrome, retaining accessible names, URL and all row metadata; do not add another button variant/system.

issues.detail: PageLayout receives query but no loading/busy/error announcement inputs. PageContainer.tsx:133-140 derives load announcements from those explicit props, not query. No page-owned live result-count region exists; initial transitions/count changes therefore lack a directly wired announcement mechanism here.
issues.fix: Wire shared busy/status announcement without replacing search controls, or use the existing status announcer for concise count updates and suppress duplicate generic announcement. Keep retained results visible.

issues.detail: Refresh omits size/target overrides; Button default md uses h-10 (Button.tsx:39). Unlike facets, it does not explicitly satisfy the stronger 44px mobile target default.
issues.fix: Give existing refresh Button a 44px minimum touch target without changing global Button sizing; verify focus/spacing on mounted UI.

inventory.name: idle
inventory.behavior: Search/facets and optional AI remain; start-typing guidance; no summary or typed request.

inventory.name: too short
inventory.behavior: Minimum-length guidance; hook disabled; no old typed results or summary.

inventory.name: initial loading
inventory.behavior: Five row skeletons plus header skeleton; summary loading suppresses resolved values.

inventory.name: fatal error
inventory.behavior: QueryError with retry; controls/AI survive; summary and header refresh hidden.

inventory.name: resolved empty
inventory.behavior: No-results guidance including query; measured returned counts are zero.

inventory.name: success
inventory.behavior: Occupied type groups with counts and all title/subtitle/when/navigation rows; numeric summary and dominant category.

inventory.name: retained refresh failure/offline
inventory.behavior: useDataState distinguishes fatal from refresh error; shared warning keeps retained rows and offers retry. Paused retained data marks shared warning stale.

inventory.name: AI disabled/idle/streaming/error/done-empty
inventory.behavior: withAiFeature gate; independent local prompt; AIFeatureCard disabled/busy CTA; AiOutputPanel.tsx:80-121 handles pending, error, empty completion, prose and evidence.

issues.detail: initialLoading depends on isFetching, not pending/paused state. For a valid query started offline with no cache, isFetching is false and no fatalError exists, so the page can enter No results even though no successful answer exists. StaleRefreshWarning.tsx:57 returns null without data.
issues.fix: Distinguish unresolved/paused initial source from successful empty using existing DataStateNotice and source state; keep controls and retry reachable, never imply confirmed zero.

issues.detail: useSearch.ts:65 retains previous valid-query payload as placeholderData. Summary scope immediately uses the new trimmed query/types while counts/rows may describe the previous search; page does not inspect isPlaceholderData or data.query. Existing stale warning is not sufficient to identify this cross-query retention.
issues.fix: Preserve no-flicker placeholder behavior but visibly distinguish pending requested query/filter scope from retained result scope and avoid attributing old counts/top category to new criteria.

issues.detail: Summary retained flag only checks isError, so paused retained data can still say Source available while the adjacent shared warning says offline/stale. Freshness prop is omitted and wrapper falls back to observation time not supplied, despite state.updatedAt being available as a client receipt time.
issues.fix: Pass actual trust state and explicitly labeled last successful receipt metadata to existing summary; never present client receipt as entity observation time.

visualIssues.detail: Result categories use neonColorMap with cyan/blue/green/red/amber/purple chip backgrounds/rings and fixed 300-level glyph colors. tokens.ts:21-26 confirms neon classes; these encode entity identity rather than status and repeat per group and row. Page does not use glow, but rainbow decoration and fixed colors remain source-confirmed reduced-noise gaps.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse neutral theme-aware icon/surface tokens and restrained accents where meaningful; preserve icons, entity labels/counts and user theme preferences. Do not replace tokens globally in a page task.

visualIssues.detail: Shared output frame uses fixed bg-white/[0.02], fixed text-red-300 error text and raw typography classes at lines 92-119 rather than canonical semantic surface/error/typography roles. Visible on this page only when AI output exists.
visualIssues.fix: Shared AI owner should use existing surface/error tokens and typography wrappers while retaining alert semantics, prose whitespace, all output states, activity and usage.

architectureIssues.detail: Sub-search errors are omitted from the response; SearchResponse carries only hits/query. Page cannot distinguish successful complete empty search from empty/partial results caused by failed entity sources. This is an observed contract limitation, not permission for frontend to invent partial status.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should expose backwards-compatible source completeness/failure metadata and type it in the shared hook; presentation can then show actual partial/unavailable trust without discarding successful groups.

architectureIssues.detail: Frontend minimum length counts UTF-16 code units while handler.go:126 counts Unicode runes. A single astral character meets frontend floor but not backend floor, yielding an apparent no-match response rather than minimum-length guidance.
architectureIssues.fix: Shared search owner should align the minimum-length predicate with backend Unicode semantics and use it in page/palette; preserve two-character default and query/cache behavior.

order: Correct offline initial-empty and cross-query retained-scope trust
Resolve backend completeness metadata and shared Unicode guard
Restore native navigation and reliable announcements/targets
Reduce category/AI decoration and validate responsive localized content
priority.reason: Trust gaps can imply zero or assign previous-query results to current criteria. Layout is already full-width and uses existing architecture; no source rewrite or feature removal is justified.

competingImplementations.fix: Consolidate metadata only; retain both purposeful search entry points and their limits/interaction contracts.

competingImplementations.detail: AI prompt is independent, explicitly gated and additive rather than a replacement typed-search implementation. Workspace search intentionally hides global vehicle picker (workspaceScope.ts:110-127) and owns no duplicate vehicle/date selector.
competingImplementations.fix: Preserve these separations; do not introduce another workspace scope, AI gate, stats renderer or layout wrapper.

dataBehavior: Keep exact route /search and restore q/types from shared URLs.
Keep current search type ordering, server within-group ranking, titles, optional subtitle/when and backend destinations.
Keep 25-per-type page limit, raw query key identities, inherited retry/staleness/cancellation and null normalization.
Keep measured zero distinct from unresolved/missing values and bounded returned totals distinct from unbounded server totals.
Keep initial, empty, fatal-retry, retained-error and independent AI states; fix trust gaps without removing sources.
Keep optional AI off gate and typed baseline, stream prose, source provenance/activity/usage and prompt validation.
No physical-unit fields are calculated by this page; maintain raw API/cache values and current date/locale/format preferences.
No tables, charts, exports or destructive mutations are implemented by this page; do not invent them.
